title: US Code /us/usc/t15/s2064/b — fresh checker study

uslm_source.xml:
<ns0:uscDoc xmlns:ns0="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0 USLM-1.0.15.xsd" xml:lang="en" identifier="/us/usc/t15"><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id6bb83cd8-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s2064/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Noncompliance with applicable consumer product safety rules; product defects; notice to Commission by manufacturer, distributor, or retailer</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Every manufacturer of a consumer product, or other product or substance over which the Commission has jurisdiction under any other Act enforced by the Commission (other than motor vehicle equipment as defined in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t49/s30102/a/7">section 30102(a)(7) of title 49</ns0:ref> <ns0:ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn002426">1</ns0:ref><ns0:note type="footnote" id="fn002426"><ns0:num>1</ns0:num> See References in Text note below.</ns0:note>), distributed in commerce, and every distributor and retailer of such product, who obtains information which reasonably supports the conclusion that such product—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id6bb83cd9-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s2064/b/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> fails to comply with an applicable consumer product safety rule or with a voluntary consumer product safety standard upon which the Commission has relied under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t15/s2058">section 2058 of this title</ns0:ref>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id6bb83cda-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s2064/b/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> fails to comply with any other rule, regulation, standard, or ban under this chapter or any other Act enforced by the Commission;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id6bb83cdb-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s2064/b/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:content> contains a defect which could create a substantial product hazard described in subsection (a)(2); or</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id6bb83cdc-86b3-11f1-8c1e-ca5e0ea6b57b" identifier="/us/usc/t15/s2064/b/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:content> creates an unreasonable risk of serious injury or death,</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>

<ns0:continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall immediately inform the Commission of such failure to comply, of such defect, or of such risk, unless such manufacturer, distributor, or retailer has actual knowledge that the Commission has been adequately informed of such defect, failure to comply, or such risk. A report provided under paragraph (2) may not be used as the basis for criminal prosecution of the reporting person under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t15/s1264">section 1264 of this title</ns0:ref>, except for offenses which require a showing of intent to defraud or mislead.</ns0:continuation>
</ns0:subsection>
</ns0:uscDoc>
